main.node: Fetch YC Work at a Startup

meta.notes:
SETUP REQUIRED before activating:
1. Replace YOUR_SPREADSHEET_ID with your Google Spreadsheet ID.
2. Create Google Sheets credential and replace GOOGLE_SHEETS_CREDENTIAL_ID.
3. Create Gmail OAuth2 credential and replace GMAIL_CREDENTIAL_ID.
4. Set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY as an environment variable in n8n.
5. Replace YOUR_EMAIL@gmail.com in both Gmail nodes.
6. Create Google Sheet with 4 tabs: Raw Jobs, Filtered Jobs, Applied, Rejected.
   Add the column headers listed in the workflow spec to each tab (row 1).
7. For Wellfound, YC, and Otta: replace the HTTP fetch nodes with Apify or ScrapingBee scraper calls that return JSON.
8. Activate the workflow. It will run every day at 8:30 AM Asia/Taipei time.
